ecom-dry-aged-page.textcontent_tfk5zkt29k_html: This is where you get it all, where meat ages with flavor.
ecom-dry-aged-page.text0_bfnexpp19ta_html: Dry Aging intensifies the meat's natural falvours, resulting in a richer and more complex taste

ecom-dry-aged-page.textcontent_jgnoiimxlh8_html: At MLS, we're taking this timeless tradition to the next level, offering you a taste like no other.
ecom-dry-aged-page.timeline_content0_vu20io93fv9_html: In the first week, dry-aged meat begins its transformation.
ecom-dry-aged-page.timeline_content1_vu20io93fv9_html: Flavors intensify, with subtle nuttiness and sweetness.

ecom-dry-aged-page.timeline_content0_mkxvh20rjl_html: In the first week, dry-aged meat begins its transformation, like the opening chapter of a story.

ecom-dry-aged-page.timeline_content3_mkxvh20rjl_html: In the fourth week, the meat reaches its climax, incredibly tender, with intense beefiness.

ecom-our-story-new-page.textcontent_i7poq50enz_html: We not only make the country’s finest red meat, but through sustainable job creation, we empower our farmers and butchers to build a brighter future. Our strategy is to focus first on identifying consumer needs, then work with our farmers to grow animals and apply our expertise to meet those needs.
ecom-our-story-new-page.textcontent_d0u037gmgxo_html: We come from a family of butchers, passionate about red meat, and livestock. A family business started from a butcher shop in Ibra, Oman, 1977- today we exist to nourish people with nature's finest red meat.

ecom-our-story-new-page.textcontent_l6su3yflbf_html: For decades, we are maintaining the strict standards to deliver humanely raised red meat, 100% grass-fed and grain-fed. we are nourishing people with nature's finest red meat. We provide consumers, who want quality and experiences from their food, with an entire range of red meat products including grain-fed, hormone-free and antibiotic-free.
ecom-our-story-new-page.textcontent_kbc6nzqpd38_html: We believe business not only has the ability to be a part of environmental solutions, but also a moral responsibility to address them.We are the first carbon neutral company in Oman. MLS has committed to the United Nations’ Climate Neutral Now initiative – estimating, reducing and compensating its greenhouse gas emissions in an effort to make no net release into the atmosphere.
